name: art
description: art@1: twelve painterly looks named by technique, each with motifs, a signature transition and edge, a preview of one shared test scene in 2D and 3D, its measured cost and its known limits.

art.mosaic@1.about: Mosaic: square tesserae tile px across, each the color at its centre with a seeded shade, set in darker grout.

art.wash@1.about: Wash: transparent pigment that pools darker at its edges and granulates, its edges wandering a few px.

art.ink_wash@1.about: Ink wash: the frame as ink tones on warm paper, bleeding into its neighbours, darkest at its edges.

art.halftone@1.about: Halftone: the frame as dots of its own colors on a 45 degree screen pitch px apart, larger where darker; dark keylines stay solid.

art.neon@1.about: Neon: each edge of the frame as a bright tube in the color beside it, with a soft halo, the fills dimmed behind.

art.keyline@1.about: Keyline: the frame's color edges inked in the look's ink, heavier where the step is larger.

art.flow_brush.description: art@1: long loaded strokes that follow each surface, on cold-press paper
limits: Strokes run along each surface's u direction: a flow field waits on vector fields (#225)
Strokes lie on marks' surfaces, never on the ground

art.dab.description: art@1: short square-ended dabs laid side by side, broken color
limits: Every dab has one shape, soft-ended; a dab's size varies only within its range
Strokes lie on marks' surfaces, never on the ground

art.dot.description: art@1: small dots of pure color set close, mixing in the eye
limits: Dots are round dabs 9 to 10 px across at design size, smaller on far surfaces; they never follow a flow field
Dots lie on marks' surfaces, never on the ground

art.wash.description: art@1: transparent watercolor washes that pool, bloom and granulate
limits: The wash is drawn over the finished frame: its edges darken where colors meet, not where items overlap

art.ink_wash.description: art@1: ink in graded washes on absorbent paper, black to the palest grey
limits: Monochrome by design: every color reads only as an ink tone

art.halftone_pop.description: art@1: flat pop colors printed as offset halftone dots, black keylines
limits: One 45 degree screen: every color shares its angle and pitch, so no rosette forms

art.neon_tape.description: art@1: glowing tube lines on a dark wall, colors that bleed light
limits: Tubes follow color edges: two fills of one brightness meet with no tube

art.cel_light.description: art@1: flat cel shading in hard bands of light and shade, inked outlines
limits: Bands come from posterizing the frame: a smooth gradient steps, and keylines ink every color edge, not only outlines

art.chiaroscuro.description: art@1: strong light against deep shadow, forms carved out of the dark
limits: Shadows deepen toward the frame's edge: subjects at the border sink

art.cut_paper.description: art@1: shapes cut from colored paper, layered with soft shadows between sheets
limits: Each sheet is one flat color; a gradient reads as its mean

art.mosaic.description: art@1: small square tesserae set in grout, each one color
limits: Tesserae are square and on a fixed grid of 14 px: they don't follow a form, and a line thinner than a tile breaks

art.gold_leaf.description: art@1: a burnished gold-leaf ground with red bole and azurite, tooled lines and cracked gilding
limits: The leaf's gleam is drawn, not reflected: it doesn't move with the light
